rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when putting a file, photo, or other data online; it is the default spoken choice.

example.english: I’ll upload it online for you to see later.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan6 gaan1 fong3 soeng5 mong5 bei2 nei5 tai2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose technical equivalent, especially for transferring a file or data to a server.

example.english: Please upload the file to the server.
example.traditional: 請將檔案上載到伺服器。
example.jyutping: cing2 zoeng1 dong2 ngon3 soeng6 zoi3 dou3 si6 fuk6 hei3
